subject: reconnecting
body:
Hi Ryan,

Ryan LaRocca here with LRG Homes. We crossed paths a while back and I wanted to get back on your radar. I'm buying single family and small multifamily in the South Bay again this fall, as-is and quick close.

If you have a listing that's been sitting or a seller who just wants it done, I'd love to take a look. Happy to grab coffee near your office if that's easier.

Ryan LaRocca
LRG Homes
(650) 910-4007

If you'd rather not hear from me, just reply "remove" and I'll take you off my list.

subject: quick one on San Jose
body:
Hi Ryan,

Quick one. I'm under contract on a duplex in Willow Glen this month and have room for one or two more in San Jose or Santa Clara before the end of the year. Anything rough, tenant occupied, or stuck in escrow works for me.

Would you have 15 minutes this week or next to catch up? I can come to you.

Ryan LaRocca
LRG Homes
(650) 910-4007

Reply "remove" if you'd prefer I not follow up.

subject: are you still working the peninsula?
body:
Hi Ryan,

Hope the summer treated you well. I'm still buying in the Bay, mostly Sunnyvale, San Jose and Santa Clara, and I'm curious whether you're still working the peninsula side too.

If so, I'd like to compare notes on what's moving and what isn't. Lunch is on me if you're around Sunnyvale.

Ryan LaRocca
LRG Homes
(650) 910-4007

Not interested? Reply "remove" and that's the end of it.
